# Themes and editor color schemes

IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 ships the *Islands* look as the default New UI appearance. Themes are layered: a theme names a `parentTheme`, defines a named color `palette` and maps UI keys (`Component.property`) to palette names or literal values. Values below are fully resolved through the parent chain. Full data: [data/themes.json](data/themes.json) and [data/color-schemes.json](data/color-schemes.json).

## Bundled UI themes

| Theme id | Name | Dark | Inherits | Editor scheme | Resolved UI keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Islands Dark` | Islands Dark | True | Darcula → ExperimentalDark → Islands Dark | Islands Dark | 1242 |
| `Islands Light` | Islands Light | False | Darcula → IntelliJ → ExperimentalLight → ExperimentalLightWithLightHeader → Islands Light | Light | 1338 |
| `Islands Darcula` | Islands Darcula | True | Darcula → ExperimentalDark → Islands Darcula | Darcula | 1204 |
| `ExperimentalDark` | Dark | True | Darcula → ExperimentalDark | Dark | 1006 |
| `ExperimentalLight` | Light | False | Darcula → IntelliJ → ExperimentalLight | Light | 1140 |
| `ExperimentalLightWithLightHeader` | Light with Light Header | False | Darcula → IntelliJ → ExperimentalLight → ExperimentalLightWithLightHeader | Light | 1142 |
| `JetBrainsHighContrastTheme` | High Contrast | True | Darcula → ExperimentalDark → Islands Dark → JetBrainsHighContrastTheme | High contrast | 1339 |
| `Darcula` | Darcula | True | Darcula | — | 670 |
| `IntelliJ` | IntelliJ | False | Darcula → IntelliJ | — | 887 |
